cypher: MATCH (c:Consumer) RETURN c.category AS category, count(c) AS consumers ORDER BY consumers DESC LIMIT 100
model: claude-haiku (агент Claude, той самий промпт v1)

cypher: MATCH (s:Substation)-[:LOCATED_IN]->(r:Region) WHERE r.name CONTAINS 'Рівнен' RETURN s.id AS substation, s.name AS name, s.currentLoad / s.nominalCapacity * 100 AS loadPercent ORDER BY loadPercent DESC LIMIT 100
model: claude-haiku (агент Claude, той самий промпт v1)

cypher: MATCH (c:Consumer)-[:HAS_METER]->(m:Meter {status: 'несправний'}) MATCH (c)-[:CONNECTED_TO]->(s:Substation) RETURN m.id AS meter, c.id AS consumer, s.id AS substation LIMIT 100
model: claude-haiku (агент Claude, той самий промпт v1)

cypher: MATCH (m:ForecastModel)-[:GENERATED]->(f:Forecast) RETURN m.id AS model, m.modelType AS modelType, count(f) AS forecasts ORDER BY forecasts DESC LIMIT 1
model: claude-haiku (агент Claude, той самий промпт v1)

cypher: MATCH (d:Dispatcher {id: 'Dispatcher_5'})-[:USES_FORECAST]->(f:Forecast)-[:FORECAST_FOR]->(s:Substation) RETURN f.id AS forecast, s.id AS substation LIMIT 100
model: claude-haiku (агент Claude, той самий промпт v1)

cypher: MATCH (root:Substation {id: 'Substation_1'})-[:FEEDS*1..]->(s:Substation) RETURN DISTINCT s.id AS substation LIMIT 100
model: claude-haiku (агент Claude, той самий промпт v1)

cypher: MATCH (m:ForecastModel)-[:GENERATED]->(f:Forecast) RETURN m.modelType AS modelType, avg(f.errorPercentage) AS avgErrorPercentage ORDER BY avgErrorPercentage LIMIT 100
model: claude-haiku (агент Claude, той самий промпт v1)

cypher: MATCH (c:Consumer)-[:CONNECTED_TO]->(s:Substation) WHERE s.currentLoad >= 0.85 * s.nominalCapacity RETURN c.id AS consumer, s.id AS substation, s.currentLoad / s.nominalCapacity * 100 AS loadPercent ORDER BY loadPercent DESC LIMIT 100
model: claude-haiku (агент Claude, той самий промпт v1)

cypher: MATCH (c:Consumer {id: 'Consumer_1002'}), (d:Dispatcher {id: 'Dispatcher_4'}), p = shortestPath((c)-[*]-(d)) RETURN [n IN nodes(p) | n.id] AS path, length(p) AS hops LIMIT 1
model: claude-haiku (агент Claude, той самий промпт v1)

cypher: MATCH (w:WeatherCondition)-[:AFFECTS_MODEL]->(m:ForecastModel) WHERE w.temperature < -10 RETURN DISTINCT m.id AS model, m.modelType AS modelType LIMIT 100
model: claude-haiku (агент Claude, той самий промпт v1)

cypher: MATCH (s:Substation) WHERE NOT (s)<-[:FORECAST_FOR]-(:Forecast) RETURN s.id AS substation, s.name AS name LIMIT 100
model: claude-haiku (агент Claude, той самий промпт v1)

cypher: MATCH (c:Consumer)-[:HAS_METER]->(m:Meter), (c)-[:CONNECTED_TO]->(s:Substation)-[:LOCATED_IN]->(r:Region) RETURN r.name AS region, count(m) AS meters, sum(CASE WHEN m.status = 'несправний' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS brokenMeters, avg(CASE WHEN m.status = 'несправний' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) AS brokenShare ORDER BY brokenShare DESC LIMIT 100
model: claude-haiku (агент Claude, той самий промпт v1)

cypher: MATCH (m:Measurement) WHERE m.timestamp >= localdatetime('2026-09-28T00:00:00') AND m.timestamp < localdatetime('2026-09-29T00:00:00') RETURN m.id AS measurement, m.timestamp AS timestamp, m.consumptionValue AS consumptionValue, m.voltage AS voltage ORDER BY m.timestamp LIMIT 100
model: claude-haiku (агент Claude, той самий промпт v1)

cypher: MATCH (d:Dispatcher)-[:MANAGES]->(s:Substation) MATCH (s)-[:FEEDS*0..]->(down:Substation) WITH d, collect(DISTINCT down) AS subs MATCH (c:Consumer)-[:CONNECTED_TO]->(x:Substation) WHERE x IN subs WITH d, collect(DISTINCT c) AS consumers RETURN d.id AS dispatcher, size(consumers) AS consumers, reduce(t = 0.0, x IN consumers | t + x.contractLimit) AS totalContractLimit ORDER BY totalContractLimit DESC LIMIT 100
model: claude-haiku (агент Claude, той самий промпт v1)

cypher: MATCH (d:Dispatcher)-[:MANAGES]->(s:Substation)<-[:CONNECTED_TO]-(c:Consumer) RETURN d.id AS dispatcher, count(DISTINCT c) AS consumers ORDER BY consumers DESC LIMIT 1
model: claude-haiku (агент Claude, той самий промпт v1)
